painting-mss.name: scroll; manuscript

household.name: Bag

household.reason: A beaded bandolier bag with floral and geometric glass-bead panels and a red wool body, a classic Great Lakes Ojibwe accessory form, matching the museum's attribution to Ojibwa work of the period.

household.name: smoking-pipe
household.title: smoking-pipe

household.name: medicine-bag
household.title: medicine-bag

household.name: Charm bag
household.title: Charm Bag
household.reason: A twined woolen storage/charm bag with geometric diamond patterning and a zoomorphic figure (likely a "underwater panther" or similar Anishinaabe motif), a well-documented Ojibwe craft form (bandolier-bag-related yarn twining). Matches the claimed Ojibwe attribution.

household.name: ask, basket, mi kak
household.title: ask, basket, mi kak
household.reason: A birch bark basket (mi kak/wigwas) stitched with root or bark lacing, a classic Ojibwe (Chippewa) container documented as collected in Minnesota/Wisconsin, well within Ojibwe material culture and homeland.

household.name: vagga, crib, cot, cradle, a´dikina´gun

household.name: ask, box
household.title: ask, box
household.reason: A cylindrical birchbark box/basket with sewn bark seams and wavy-cut decorative rim strips, from Minnesota — a classic Ojibwe birchbark container form.

household.name: lacrosse-stick
household.title: lacrosse-stick

household.name: Knife sheath
household.title: Knife Case
household.reason: The image shows a beaded, fringed knife sheath in hide with glass beadwork, wool, and silk tassels — a classic Ojibwa/Woodlands quillwork-and-beadwork accessory, matching the claimed culture and object type.

household.name: fat, plate
household.title: fat, plate

household.name: adze; axe

household.name: modell, kanot
household.title: modell, kanot
household.reason: The image shows a miniature birchbark canoe model, sewn with spruce root/cord over ribs—a traditional Ojibwe/Anishinaabe craft form well documented for this culture and region (Minnesota).

household.name: väska, bag, bolsa
household.title: väska, bag, bolsa
household.reason: A beaded floral bag with fringe, consistent with Great Lakes Ojibwe/Chippewa beadwork (floral style on cloth with tin-cone-free hide fringe), matching the museum's own Chippewa/Ojibwe attribution.

household.name: lacrosse-stick
household.title: lacrosse-stick

instruments.name: smoking-pipe

instruments.name: flute
instruments.title: flute
